name: cross-surface-final-closure
executionConcern: same-candidate Control Panel section completeness, cross-surface readback, security/isolation, contract/database/runtime/visual evidence, cleanup and final decision
objective: Prove the exact final candidate has no remaining Control Panel root-cause blocker, parallel truth, stale binding, unhandled failure mode or directly affected surface divergence before closure is claimed.
truthOwner: Verification only; canonical ownership remains with Identity, Workforce, Platform Control, Providers, DSH and WLT.
journeys: all current Control Panel sections and hidden/detail routes

tasks.objective: Prove every Control Panel section, hidden route, control class and negative scenario on one candidate
tasks.currentProblem: Static green checks can miss route/object authorization, scope leakage, stale conflict, duplicate submit, response-loss, dependency degradation, missing UI states or accessibility/RTL defects.
tasks.requiredChange: Re-pin the final candidate; execute registry-guided authorized/forbidden/out-of-scope/stale/duplicate/response-loss/dependency-recovery scenarios across every current section and hidden route, including search/filter/sort/pagination/bulk/audit/session behavior.
tasks.targetState: All Control Panel paths show canonical success and explicit loading/empty/error/forbidden/stale/conflict/unknown-result behavior with no misleading fallback.
tasks.action: Run automated owner/contract/database checks first, then same-candidate runtime and visual/manual scenarios; fix discovered root causes in the owning earlier unit and rerun affected evidence before proceeding.
mustNotChange: Do not waive a failing scenario because the UI appears usable.
Do not treat a derived registry as higher authority than Product Truth/contracts.
Do not spread evidence across different candidate SHAs.
acceptanceCriteria: Every current section and hidden route has same-candidate runtime evidence for applicable states/actions.
Authorization/object scope/search/bulk/conflict/retry/response-loss/dependency recovery are proven where applicable.
RTL, keyboard/focus, screen-reader semantics and large-text behavior are verified visually/manually.
tasks.rollback: No product rollback is performed by verification itself; send failures back to the owning unit and invalidate affected evidence.
tasks.commitBoundary: No closure commit until all required automated and manual evidence is tied to one final candidate.

tasks.objective: Prove repository, owner, finance and direct multi-surface closure and remove obsolete remnants
tasks.currentProblem: A candidate can retain duplicate owner logic, stale generated clients, obsolete fallbacks or directly affected surface drift even when the primary Control Panel route works.
tasks.requiredChange: Run full owner tests/guards/contracts/runtime smoke, inspect final diff for duplicate truth/fallback/remnants, verify direct Client/Partner/Captain/Field readbacks only where linked, confirm financial and protected approvals, and classify any final branch movement before decision.
tasks.targetState: One final SHA contains one owner per fact, no obsolete parallel implementation, aligned contracts/generated clients/database state, direct surface convergence and all required independent evidence.
tasks.action: Execute the closure matrix; delete proven-obsolete remnants only after replacement evidence; re-resolve BB immediately before final decision and reconcile any related delta.
mustNotChange: Do not force-push or overwrite concurrent branch work.
Do not pull unrelated areas into the candidate to chase generic cleanliness.
acceptanceCriteria: All required owner/contract/database/boundary checks pass on the exact candidate.
No parallel truth/fallback/obsolete path remains in the verified scope.
Required independent Product Truth approvals/evidence are present or the decision remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE rather than falsely closed.
tasks.rollback: Invalidate closure evidence and return to the owning unit on any failure or branch movement; do not preserve a false closed state.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final evidence bookkeeping only after the branch head and candidate SHA are re-resolved and unchanged or reconciled.
